findings.reason: A pinned plan anchors the receiver and all14 actual installed files. The receiver enumerates the full four-directory inventory, rejects extra/missing files and symlinks, compares bytes/SHA256/Git blobs/modes to the external plan, and independently fixes the original three product asset identities. This covers the opener's recorded-file-only inventory limitation.

The driver spawns the exact installed executable path with --check and --no-open, lets the OS use its shebang, records actual argv/PID/stdout/stderr/exit/close, and checks the complete JSON result against the plan. Neither flag requests desktop opening. The URL used by the page equals the independently validated installed HTML URL.

One exclusive private profile supplies the bounded DevToolsActivePort record, an ephemeral127.0.0.1 instrumentation endpoint and actual Browser.getVersion response. Native source/file pins and version are required. Child close/stdio state is recorded separately from page readiness. No speculative change was made from the separate unresolved Raider startup result.

Each receiver-created PGID is selected individually using ps -g, wide output and per-call COMMAND_MODE=unix2003/LC_ALL=C. Exact-profile pgrep results feed bounded exact-PID ps observations. Queries have explicit timeout/output/row/history caps and recorded exit/hash metadata. Unrelated full-host command output is no longer collected.

Group signals require fresh live-created-leader or previously observed group-member continuity (PID/PGID/UID/start record). The leader and individual fallback require no exit event, null exitCode and null signalCode. Terminal/close remains the separate pipe-completion predicate. Empty terminal groups retire on their child sequence; an unrelated later reused numeric PID does not inherit that record. Exact-profile matches outside established groups remain unresolved closure evidence and are never blanket signal targets.

The receiver records owned members before Browser.close, waits for ChildProcess close and bounded group/profile census, then retains any scoped TERM/KILL requests and incomplete closure as failure. Profiles and original evidence remain retained. Its evidence is scoped to created groups/identified profile matches and does not establish global orphan-free state.

The driver uses CDP key/mouse input for the visible preset, Load example, vertex selector and three download buttons, with trusted DOM-event records. DOM evaluation only focuses/inspects. Browser events bind each download GUID to the installed main frame; the completed native GUID file is read and hashed. Course/guide match original exact bytes; observation is checked against the frozen single fractional witness. No app handler, solver or download serializer is called to manufacture evidence.

The installed file URL is used directly. One fractional worked example, one observation/course/guide download sequence, one rendered capture and one new-tab reopen are planned. Existing mathematical/application qualification is reused; the original ten-group campaign is not replayed. Outside page requests, errors or unexpected storage fail the receiver.

The final stage rereads the same four runtime files and compares complete before/after records, in addition to the installed inventory, retained author sources, plan and driver. Large native metadata is retained as strings.

Fresh kern.bootsessionuuid must equal both the pinned plan and47865B22-BECE-4090-92BD-88664552E3A6 before receiver writes/spawn. Raw kern.boottime is preserved as calendar provenance without equality gating. The earlier pre-placement refusal remains intact and earlier observations lacking a session UUID are not retroactively rebound.

The2GiB memory floor,256MiB disk floor,64MiB receiver state cap,8MiB capture cap,100s active-work deadline,115s emergency deadline and120s browser cap remain. No default profile, server, product port, dependency/runtime install, service, shared configuration, physical keyboard, Finder, Commons/Hub or Actions claim is added.
